_comment: Models for the end-to-end tokens/s experiment (scripts/e2e). Keys are the --model tags; gguf is fetched by scripts/e2e/fetch_model.sh into ~/models/<file>. bytes_per_token from scripts/e2e/qwen35_inventory.py (Q4_K_M, decode).

qwen3.5-4b.note: smallest hybrid-GDN Qwen; ~24 tok/s @4 threads class

qwen3.8-27b.note: newest dense Qwen; same qwen35 arch (64 layers + 1 MTP layer skipped in decode); ~3-4 tok/s bandwidth-bound on 16 cores

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.note: NOT supported yet: 8/256-expert mul_mat_id ops carry ~30% of decode bytes and the override hook only intercepts 2-D mul_mat
